description: This file defines an Angular service 'AppSelectors' that provides reactive, computed views over the application state stored in 'AppStore'. It includes derived selectors for various requirements and timeline milestones, facilitating components' access to specific state views.

classes.name: AppSelectors
classes.description: A service that exposes computed signals for different slices and derived data from the application store.

methods.name: requirements
methods.description: Direct pass-through to the requirements slice in the store.

methods.name: architecture
methods.description: Access to the architecture slice in the store.

methods.name: resources
methods.description: Access to the resources slice in the store.

methods.name: timeline
methods.description: Access to the timeline slice in the store.

methods.name: ui
methods.description: Access to the UI state slice in the store.

methods.name: openRequirements
methods.description: Computed list of requirements with status 'open' or undefined (defaulting to 'open').

methods.name: inProgressRequirements
methods.description: Computed list of requirements with status 'in-progress'.

methods.name: doneRequirements
methods.description: Computed list of requirements with status 'done'.

methods.name: milestonesDueSoon
methods.description: Computed list of timeline milestones that are not done and due within the next two weeks, sorted by due date.

methods.name: isLoading
methods.description: Computed boolean indicating whether the UI state is in a loading state.
